title: The World Of The Unseen The 5 Truths Of Revelation

questions.question: What did the traveller do when he wanted to learn about the World of the Unseen?
questions.answer: He carefully examined it and approached it with both his mind and heart, asking what it reveals.

questions.question: From the signs in the visible world, what did he understand about the One behind the unseen veil?
questions.answer: He understood that Allah wants to be known, loved, and recognized through His blessings and wonderfully made creations.

questions.question: According to the passage, how does that Being first show Himself without spoken words?
questions.answer: Through His actions, gifts, and the condition of creation itself.

questions.question: Why did the traveller conclude that this Being would also speak?
questions.answer: Because One who makes Himself known by actions would also make Himself known by speech.

questions.question: What dominates the World of the Unseen at all times, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The reality of revelation is powerfully present throughout it.

questions.question: From whom do revelation and inspiration come in the passage?
questions.answer: They come from Allah, the Knower of the unseen.

questions.question: How is the witness of revelation described when compared with the witness of the universe?
questions.answer: It is described as even stronger.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah does not leave only to created things?
questions.answer: He does not leave knowledge of His existence and oneness only to the witness of His creatures.

questions.question: What is said about Allah’s speech in relation to time and His being?
questions.answer: It is eternal in origin and fitting to His own being.

questions.question: Besides making Allah known, what else does His speech reveal?
questions.answer: It also shows His attributes.

questions.question: What made the truth of revelation almost self-evident to the traveller?
questions.answer: The agreement of a huge number of prophets, along with the proofs and miracles found in revealed books and pages.

questions.question: What role do the holy books and pages play for people in the passage?
questions.answer: They guide most of humanity and serve as clear fruits of revelation.

questions.question: How many sacred truths does the traveller understand revelation declares at this point?
questions.answer: Five sacred truths.

questions.question: What main lesson about Allah and communication is being built through this whole passage?
questions.answer: That Allah not only shows Himself through creation but also speaks and sends revelation to make Himself known clearly.

questions.question: What question was in the traveller’s mind as he turned toward the unseen world?
questions.answer: He wanted to know what message that world gives.

questions.question: What do the beautifully made things in the visible world lead him to understand?
questions.answer: They lead him to understand that their Maker wants to introduce Himself.

questions.question: How do blessings and favors help the traveller reach that understanding?
questions.answer: They show that the Giver wants His creatures to love Him.

questions.question: What do the many skillful works point to besides power?
questions.answer: They point to hidden perfection and wisdom.

questions.question: What does “by act rather than speech” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means Allah first makes Himself known through what He does and creates.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveller draw from that about speech?
questions.answer: He concludes that Allah will also speak to make Himself known and loved.

questions.question: After entering the unseen world with his heart, what major truth does he notice first?
questions.answer: He notices that revelation is strongly present across the unseen world.

questions.question: What makes the testimony of revelation especially strong?
questions.answer: It comes directly from Allah and gives a stronger witness than created things alone.

questions.question: What important idea is taught by saying Allah does not rely only on creation’s testimony?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah Himself also declares His existence and oneness.

questions.question: How is Allah’s speech described in relation to His knowledge and power?
questions.answer: It is from the One whose knowledge and power are present everywhere.

questions.question: What two things about Allah become known through His speech?
questions.answer: His very being becomes known, and His qualities become known too.

questions.question: Whose agreement supports the truth and reality of revelation?
questions.answer: The agreement of one hundred thousand prophets supports it.

questions.question: What in the revealed books helps confirm revelation?
questions.answer: Their signs, proofs, and miracles help confirm it.

questions.question: Why are those books important for most people?
questions.answer: Because they serve as guiding examples accepted by large numbers of human beings.

questions.question: What did the traveller understand revelation announces after seeing all this evidence?
questions.answer: He understood that revelation announces five holy and foundational truths.

questions.question: Which two inner abilities did the traveller use to explore the unseen world?
questions.answer: He used his intellect and his heart.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the purpose of the decorated and orderly works in the visible world?
questions.answer: They are signs that their Maker wants to be recognized.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the purpose of the many blessings given to creation?
questions.answer: They show that the Giver wants to win love from His creatures.

questions.question: What do the many extraordinary works reveal about their Maker?
questions.answer: They reveal His hidden excellence and perfect qualities.

questions.question: Why is it reasonable in the passage that Allah would communicate by words?
questions.answer: Because making Himself known only through deeds would not be the only way; speech would also fit that purpose.

questions.question: In what way did the traveller enter the unseen world after this realization?
questions.answer: He entered it spiritually with his heart while understanding with his mind.

questions.question: What is said to be spread over every part of the unseen world?
questions.answer: The reality of revelation is spread over it with strong force.

questions.question: How does inspiration appear in relation to revelation in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: It appears alongside revelation as something also coming from Allah.

questions.question: Compared with the universe and all created beings, how is revelation’s witness described?
questions.answer: It is stronger and more direct.

questions.question: What does the statement about pre-eternal speech show about Allah’s speech?
questions.answer: It shows that His speech is not temporary or newly invented, but everlasting.

questions.question: What is the connection between Allah’s speech and His attributes?
questions.answer: His speech not only points to Him but also displays His attributes.

questions.question: What large group gives united support to the reality of revelation?
questions.answer: A vast number of prophets give united support to it.

questions.question: What other source supports revelation besides the prophets’ agreement?
questions.answer: The heavenly books and pages support it through their proofs and miracles.

questions.question: What evidence from human history is mentioned about those books?
questions.answer: Most people have taken them as guides and accepted them.

questions.question: What did the traveller realize revelation is declaring before the details are listed later?
questions.answer: He realized it is declaring five sacred truths.

questions.question: What was the traveller trying to discover when he “knocked” on the door of the unseen world?
questions.answer: He was trying to discover the message and testimony of that world.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do the crafted things in the visible world say about their Maker’s intention?
questions.answer: They show that their Maker intends to introduce Himself to His creatures.

questions.question: What do the many pleasant gifts in the world show about the relationship Allah wants with people?
questions.answer: They show that He wants to be loved.

questions.question: What do the many amazing creations show about Allah besides His existence?
questions.answer: They show His perfect qualities and excellence.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the first way Allah makes Himself known?
questions.answer: Through deeds, creation, and the natural language of things.

questions.question: What further way of communication must follow from that, according to the traveller?
questions.answer: Spoken communication and direct address must also follow.

questions.question: Where did the traveller look in order to know Allah through this kind of communication?
questions.answer: He looked to the manifestations found in the World of the Unseen.

questions.question: Why is revelation a greater proof than the universe alone?
questions.answer: Because it comes from Allah directly and gives a clearer witness to His existence and oneness.

questions.question: What mistaken idea is rejected by saying Allah does not leave testimony only to His creatures?
questions.answer: The idea that creation alone is the only evidence about Him is rejected.

questions.question: How is Allah’s speech described with regard to limit and duration?
questions.answer: It is described as without end.

questions.question: What double function does divine speech have in the passage?
questions.answer: It makes Allah known and also makes His attributes known.

questions.question: What two kinds of support make revelation’s truth very clear to the traveller?
questions.answer: The united message of the prophets and the miraculous proofs in the holy books.

questions.question: How do the sacred books act for the majority of people?
questions.answer: They act as guides and examples to follow.

questions.question: What number of core truths did the traveller understand revelation proclaims?
questions.answer: He understood that it proclaims five.

questions.question: How did the traveller approach the unseen world in this passage?
questions.answer: He approached it thoughtfully, with deep curiosity, using both heart and mind.

questions.question: What did he infer from the beauty and skill seen in the physical world?
questions.answer: He inferred that there is a Maker behind it who wants to be known.

questions.question: What do the many blessings indicate about that Maker’s will?
questions.answer: They indicate that He wants His creatures to love Him.

questions.question: What do the miraculous works of art indicate about Him?
questions.answer: They indicate hidden perfection, wisdom, and greatness.

questions.question: What is meant by making Himself known through the “tongue of disposition”?
questions.answer: It means creation itself, by the way it exists and functions, points to Him without spoken language.

questions.question: What necessary conclusion does the traveller make from this nonverbal communication?
questions.answer: He concludes that Allah must also communicate by speech.

questions.question: What did the traveller seek to know from the unseen side of reality?
questions.answer: He sought to know Allah through His manifestations there.

questions.question: What was the first major reality he saw in that realm?
questions.answer: He saw that revelation has a powerful and ongoing presence in it.

questions.question: What comes with the truths of revelation and inspiration in the passage?
questions.answer: A strong testimony to Allah’s existence and His oneness comes with them.

questions.question: Why is that testimony stronger than the witness of creatures?
questions.answer: Because it is a direct declaration from Allah, not only an indirect sign from created things.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s own speech?
questions.answer: It teaches that His speech is eternal, fitting for Him, and endless.

questions.question: In addition to Allah Himself, what does His discourse uncover?
questions.answer: It uncovers His attributes.

questions.question: What made the existence of revelation clear enough to be almost obvious?
questions.answer: The shared witness of many prophets and the confirming signs in the revealed scriptures.

questions.question: What proof inside the scriptures is mentioned?
questions.answer: Their miracles and evidences are mentioned.

questions.question: What summary conclusion did the traveller reach about revelation before hearing the details beyond this section?
questions.answer: He concluded that revelation announces five sacred truths.

questions.question: What image does the passage use for the traveller’s effort to learn from the unseen world?
questions.answer: It describes him as knocking at its door.

questions.question: What was he hoping to learn by doing that?
questions.answer: He was hoping to learn what the unseen world testifies to and teaches.

questions.question: What three aims of the Maker are understood from the visible world in this passage?
questions.answer: To be known, to be loved, and to make His hidden perfections recognized.

questions.question: Through what kind of evidence are these aims first noticed?
questions.answer: They are first noticed through created things, blessings, and beautifully made works.

questions.question: What reasoning leads the traveller from deeds to speech?
questions.answer: If Allah reveals Himself through actions, then it makes sense that He would also reveal Himself through words.

questions.question: What part of the traveller enters the unseen world in a special way here?
questions.answer: His heart enters, while his intellect observes and understands.

questions.question: What is the great truth he notices throughout the unseen world?
questions.answer: He notices the strong and constant rule of revelation there.

questions.question: What two things do revelation and inspiration testify to very powerfully?
questions.answer: They testify to Allah’s existence and His unity.

questions.question: How does this testimony compare with the testimony of the created universe?
questions.answer: It is stronger than the universe’s testimony.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s direct self-disclosure?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah does not only let creation speak about Him; He also speaks Himself.

questions.question: What qualities of Allah are connected in the passage to His speech being everywhere relevant?
questions.answer: His knowledge and power are connected to it.

questions.question: What effect does Allah’s speech have on human understanding of Him?
questions.answer: It helps people know both Him and His attributes.

questions.question: Which human messengers are named as evidence for revelation’s truth in a general sense?
questions.answer: The prophets as a united body are named as evidence.

questions.question: What written sources also support that truth?
questions.answer: The revealed books and heavenly pages support it.

questions.question: What did the traveller understand revelation to be announcing in a structured way?
questions.answer: He understood that it proclaims five sacred truths.
